products_text: Frydek Heritage Farm is a small local farm specializing in pasture raised meat, eggs and vegetables. The farm is located just outside of Houston in Sealy, TX. We raise pasture raised chicken, pork, and eggs (both chicken and duck eggs). Once a year, we offer lamb from our flock of sheep.
